What You’ll Do CoverGo is looking for a Product Solutions Consultant to lead the solution-consulting and product demonstration experience across the sales cycle.

Sitting at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Delivery, you will run tailored platform demos, facilitate discovery and solution-design workshops, and translate insurer requirements into compelling, configured demonstrations of the CoverGo platform.

You are someone who actively uses AI tools as a force multiplier — to draft faster, research deeper, and operate at a pace that keeps up with a high-velocity sales environment. You should be comfortable engaging both technical evaluators and C-level decision-makers, and confident owning the technical narrative that wins enterprise insurance deals.
Lead tailored product demonstrations of the CoverGo platform across health, life, and P&C use cases, adapting the story to each insurer's priorities
Design and facilitate discovery calls, solution-design sessions, and client workshops to understand, analyze, and clarify requirements and scope
Build and configure proof-of-concept insurance products in the CoverGo platform to showcase capabilities and features to clients
Use AI tools (e.g. LLMs, prompt engineering, AI-assisted research) as a core part of the workflow — to generate demo scripts, draft RFP/RFI responses, produce proposals, and accelerate content turnaround across the presales cycle
Partner with the Sales team throughout the sales conversion process, providing solution consulting that advances and closes opportunities
Translate client requirements into solution overviews, value propositions, and techno-commercial proposals
Collaborate with Solutions Architects, Product, and Engineering/Delivery teams on feasibility, effort estimation, and the best solution approach for each client
Support the handover to the Delivery team once deals are closed-won, and help lead project kick-off meetings
Provide enablement and training to develop clients' usage of the platform through technical information and guidance
Build and maintain a reusable library of demo assets, templates, and a presales knowledge base to scale the function and reduce repeat effort
Any other task that may be assigned

Bachelor's degree in Insurance, Technology, Business Administration, Sales, or a related field
5+ years of experience in presales, solution consulting, sales engineering, or pre-sales business analysis
Strong experience working in the insurance or insurtech industry is required
Strong proficiency with AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or equivalent LLM-based tools) and the ability to apply them practically to presales workflows such as demo prep, content creation, and proposal writing is required

Solid understanding of insurance business processes across at least one line of business (e.g. product setup, underwriting, pricing, policy administration, endorsements, billing, renewals, and/or claims)
Experience configuring and demonstrating SaaS platforms; exposure to no-code or low-code platforms is an advantage
Exceptional presentation and communication capabilities in written and verbal English, proficiency in other languages is an advantage

Strong storytelling ability able to make platform value tangible and relevant to each audience
Excellent facilitation, interpersonal, and stakeholder-management skills with the ability to engage an audience

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies.

With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Shield AI is hiring a Field Solutions Engineer, Hivemind to support technical sales, customer engagements, demonstrations, and capture activities for Hivemind, Shield AI’s autonomy solution for intelligent, mission-capable unmanned systems.
Hivemind enables autonomous operation across complex mission environments, allowing aircraft and other robotic systems to perceive, decide, coordinate, and execute with reduced operator burden. This role will serve as a customer-facing technical expert for Hivemind, helping defense and security customers understand how autonomy can solve operational problems, improve mission outcomes, and integrate into existing and future force structures.
The Field Solutions Engineer will translate customer mission needs, CONOPs, operational constraints, and platform integration considerations into credible, technically feasible Hivemind solution concepts. This includes supporting customer discovery, technical briefings, demonstrations, RFIs, RFPs, white papers, technical interchange meetings, and customer-specific solution development.
Success requires technical credibility, strong communication, product truth, and the ability to connect Hivemind’s autonomy capabilities to real customer missions across varied operational environments.

Serve as a customer-facing technical expert for Hivemind autonomy solutions in markets.
Support customer discovery, technical briefings, demonstrations, technical interchange meetings, and capture activities.
Translate customer mission needs, CONOPs, operational objectives, and integration constraints into credible Hivemind solution concepts.
Partner with Business Development and Capture teams to support RFIs, RFPs, proposals, white papers, demos, and customer-facing technical narratives.
Explain Hivemind autonomy capabilities, limitations, roadmap considerations, and integration requirements to technical, operational, commercial, and leadership audiences.
Develop and maintain technical sales assets, including capability briefs, demo scripts, solution templates, FAQs, technical white papers, and customer-specific briefing materials.
Work closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Engagement, and Program teams to represent customer requirements, technical risks, roadmap gaps, and field feedback.
Help customers evaluate how autonomy can support operational effectiveness, mission planning, force modernization, and fielded mission outcomes.
Maintain strong product truth by ensuring customer-facing materials and discussions accurately reflect current capabilities, constraints, and roadmap timing.
Monitor relevant developments in autonomy, AI, unmanned systems, mission software, and defense technology to inform customer conversations and product feedback.
Build trusted relationships with customer technical stakeholders and internal cross-functional partners.
Operate independently across complex customer engagements while keeping internal stakeholders aligned and informed.

7+ years of experience in solutions engineering, field applications engineering, systems engineering, technical sales, autonomy, robotics, defense software, aerospace, or related technical customer-facing roles.
Strong technical understanding of autonomy, AI-enabled systems, mission software, unmanned systems, robotics, or complex defense technology systems.
Experience supporting customer-facing technical engagements such as demos, technical briefings, proposal support, integration discussions, technical interchange meetings, or operational workshops.
Ability to translate customer mission needs into technically feasible solution concepts, requirements, demos, and product feedback.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical, operational, commercial, and leadership audiences.
Ability to work cross-functionally with Business Development, Product Management, Engineering, Customer Engagement, and Program teams.
Strong judgment in representing product capabilities, limitations, and roadmap dependencies to customers.
Demonstrated ability to build trust with customers and internal stakeholders through technical credibility, responsiveness, and clear communication.
Ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize competing demands, and execute independently in a fast-paced environment.
Willingness and ability to travel for customer engagements, demonstrations, exercises, and internal meetings.

Prior military, defense, aerospace, robotics, unmanned systems, or advanced technology domains (military or civilian).
Direct experience working with U.S. Navy or U.S. Air Force customers, programs, or operational units, including familiarity with relevant mission sets, platforms, and acquisition processes.
Experience with autonomous systems (air, ground, or maritime) and familiarity with autonomy workflows, mission planning, system integration, and operational evaluation.
Hands-on experience with Python, C++, Linux, APIs, SDKs, autonomy software, robotics middleware, or technical prototyping.
Demonstrated ability to create clear, reusable technical content that enables BD, customers, and internal stakeholders.

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . Notion is reimagining how enterprise software is sold and the Solutions Consultant is the cornerstone of that model. As a SC, you’ll own the full customer journey: from first meeting through workflow design, commercial close, workflow implementation, expansion & renewal planning.

You are the single owner of your accounts, accountable for ensuring what you sell actually gets realized. You’ll build live in front of customers, translate workflow designs into commercial outcomes, and be a trusted partner with genuine continuity across the entire relationship.

If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.
This role will be based in Paris, France. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

Own the full customer lifecycle—new logo, expansion, and renewal—as the single account owner for your book of business, with responsibility for ensuring credits sold translate into credits consumed
Design and build workflow solutions live with customers: the discovery is the demo, not the slide deck—you’ll run discovery, design current-to-future-state workflow architecture, and co-build in Notion with the customer
Partner with BDRs on target account planning and co-own the outbound motion for your book, running direct outreach to priority stakeholders alongside BDR-sourced pipeline
Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path
Guide customers through early implementation with a clear adoption plan and handoff to Outcomes Architects for ongoing multi-workflow expansion

Experience selling technical products to technical buyers
Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot in front of a customer without a specialist in the room
Strong discovery and qualification instincts, with the ability to map customer workflows and translate them into commercial outcomes and adoption plans
Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder interactions including procurement, legal, and security review cycles
You can own the room - you operate with agency and urgency to bring new ideas and workflows to our customers and present simple ways to solve complex problems
You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools & learning new ways of working
Fluency in English and French

Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new logo acquisition and expansion motions
Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software
Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals
Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or CS team as part of an integrated customer motion

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next.
For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.
Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.
We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.

We are looking for a Senior Partner Solutions Engineer to join our partnerships team in EMEA. This role will lead enablement and pre-sales motions with Vercel's solution and consulting partners (SIs and GSIs) across the region, with a primary focus on the DACH market. Partner Solutions Engineers work with partner engineering, sales, and product teams to grow adoption of Vercel's products and build strong technical relationships.
A key focus in this role will be growing partner-delivered capacity in the DACH region: running Vercel's partner certification program, creating and delivering technical enablement and workshops, and supporting pre-sales motions where partners are engaged. Fluency in German and/or French is essential; this is a spoken, partner-facing role.
This role will serve as a developer advocate for Vercel across solution and consulting partners. You will be the expert on building and delivering with Vercel products, including AI and agent workloads, and will establish best practices, author guides, lead workshops and hackathons, and build solutions for partner communities and Vercel teams.
Partner Solutions Engineers require a strong web development background, especially in frontend development, cloud infrastructure, networking, and modern application development. Strong coordination skills across multiple partners and time zones are essential, as is building lasting relationships with practice leads, delivery teams, and executives.
This is an in-person (hybrid) position that will require you to be based in Vercel's London or Berlin office with a required 3 days per week in office.

Serve as subject matter expert on Vercel and Next.js to partner engineering teams and leadership across EMEA.
Run Vercel's partner certification program in the region: deliver certification workshops, review certification projects, and guide partner engineers through the program.
Create and deliver technical training and enablement on Next.js and Vercel best practices, including building agents and AI applications on Vercel.
Deliver one-to-many technical workshops for partner engineering teams, and author the workshop content behind them.
Run and support partner hackathons that build partner skills and surface joint solutions.
Provide pre-sales support where partners are engaged: proofs of concept, technical deep dives, and deal unblocking alongside Vercel's sales and sales engineering teams.
Serve as the main technical contact for SIs and GSIs in the region, building lasting relationships with their engineering teams and practice leadership.
Build templates and solutions that equip partner communities with the best practices on delivering with Vercel.

You are passionate about building first-class user experiences on the web.
You have a strong understanding of web architecture, frontend development, and serverless computing.
You have 4+ years of experience as a solutions engineer advising or consulting engineering teams.
You have 6+ years of experience building and launching frontend applications using Next.js or React.
You speak German and/or French; spoken fluency in at least one of them, alongside professional English, is essential for this role.
You have worked with or within agencies, systems integrators, or consulting firms, and understand how they staff, deliver, and grow a technology practice.
You are experienced in developer relations, from training sessions and talks to producing technical content.
You have a results-driven mindset and are experienced working in a fast-paced environment.
You are comfortable working with remote, globally distributed cross-functional teams.
You have excellent communication skills and experience building and maintaining strong relationships with stakeholders.
You have experience driving the adoption of web technology or previous pre-sales experience.
You are based in EMEA and able to travel 20% of the time.

Have built and shipped AI-powered or agentic applications, ideally with the AI SDK.
Speak both German and French.
Have run certification, training, or enablement programs at scale.
Have experience with composable architectures (headless CMS, commerce, search, analytics) common in partner-delivered projects.

Inclusive Healthcare Package.
Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
Flexible Time Off.
We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.
